cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2, prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, no reinforcing strong anionic. Coco-Glucoside @13 is after Parfum @8 (recorded, not a buffer).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful cationic system (Polyquaternium-10 @10) plus several light routes: prominent proteins (Hydrolyzed Silk @6, Sericin @7) and lipid-like Glycosphingolipids @5, and post-E3 refatters (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @9, Glyceryl Oleate @15), pearlizer Glycol Distearate @17, Hydrogenated Castor Oil @18, Apricot Kernel Oil @21. C2 not met: no silicone, no prominent payload lipid, no closed-list humectant. Low is the neighbor because Polyquaternium-10 sits after the E3 point.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Polyquaternium-10 sits after the E3 point.

payload_lipid: Hydrogenated Castor Oil @18 (waxy; non-material, after W-line 8)
weak_refatter: Glycosphingolipids @5 (lipid-like additive, 6.3 weak_refatter by analogy with Lecithin)
humectantContext: Butylene Glycol @19 (solvent, not a deliberate humectant)

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate-light: Polyquaternium-10 @10 with prominent protein films @6-7 and three weak refatters; lipids only post-line.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate: Polyquaternium-10 deposition with protein film is plausibly retained; no silicone; waxy castor oil is trace.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Every family except proteins and one refatter sits after Parfum @8; no silicone; a single cationic polymer.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate: four interacting light routes (cationic polymer, protein film, weak refatters, trace waxy lipid) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue (W2: low would understate it).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the converging families are light (one post-E3 Polyquaternium-10 and hydrolyzed proteins, no silicone, no film former), there is no rich architecture, and the moderate C1 reset offsets them; this holds independently of the post-line lipids, since even material lipids would not give W-RICH limited reset. Not low: the families interact rather than standing alone, and the proteins @6-7 are prominent.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Polyquaternium-10 and protein doses unknown; trace doses would make it low.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: interacting light routes (Polyquaternium-10 @10, Hydrolyzed Silk @6, Sericin @7, refatters) against a moderate reset; lipids post W-line @8.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Every family except proteins and one refatter sits after Parfum @8; no silicone; a single cationic polymer.
